profile.summary: david-mark is a mid-level JavaScript developer with deep expertise in jQuery and legacy JavaScript systems. Their contributions focus on browser compatibility, DOM manipulation, and code optimization for minification. While their experience is heavily centered around jQuery's legacy codebase, they demonstrate strong skills in handling global object references across environments (browser vs. Node.js). The developer shows familiarity with integration testing and basic build tool workflows but lacks exposure to modern JavaScript frameworks, ES6+ features, or backend development. Their work primarily involves maintaining and refactoring existing code rather than building new systems.
